test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 15 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The National Programme for Civil Services Capacity Building (‘NPCSCB’) – ‘Mission Karmayogi’ was launched with the objective of enhancing governance through Civil Service Capacity Building. Which of the following is NOT one of the six pillars of this programme?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Physical fitness framework**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The National Civil Service Capacity Building Program (NPCSCB)** is known as **Mission Karmayogi**.
 
• The Indian bureaucracy has undergone a transformation. On **September 2, 2020**, the Union Cabinet officially unveiled it.
 
• The mission's goal is to provide the groundwork for the capacity building of Indian public employees and to improve governance in the country.
 
• The Union Cabinet has started Mission Karmayogi. Between 2020 and 2025, it intends to construct a new national architecture for civil service capacity building at the person, institutional, and process levels.
 
• To carry out this aim, the Companies Act 2013 establishes a special purpose vehicle (SPV) (a non-profit corporation).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The National Programme for Civil Services Capacity Building (NPCSCB)** aspires to produce a professional, well-trained, and forward-looking civil service that is imbued with a shared awareness of India's developmental goals, national programmes, and objectives.
 
• The NPCSCB's main goal is to improve the citizen-government interaction and make it easier to live and do business. This requires civil servants to develop both functional and behavioural competencies.
 
• The time from 2014 to 2019 was used to achieve the development pre-requisites, and the next five years will be used to meet the aspirations. **Mission Karmayogi **is part of a longer-term reform movement in public HRM and governance that began in 2015.
